title: Prototype Studio
description: Describe the idea and the Product Agent produces a runnable prototype; you can still edit manually or reference URL / image / design MCP
name: Prototype name
editorPlaceholder: Write HTML/CSS/JS here, preview updates live on the right
runHint: Prototypes run directly in a sandboxed iframe
imageHint: PNG / JPG / WEBP / GIF, up to 10 MB
imageEditorHint: Image prototype content is the uploaded storage path; upload again to replace
imageEditorSaveHint: Upload an image, then save the prototype
invalidUrl: URL must be an absolute http(s) address
mcpHint: Design MCP reference: store the MCP service URL or reference id; rendered by the design tool
cspHint: HTML runs in a strict CSP + sandboxed iframe (no external network/forms/top navigation)
restored: Restored to v{{version}} (saved as a new version)
filesHint: Add CSS/JS files to an HTML prototype; preview uses relative paths when index.html exists
deleteFileConfirm: The file will be removed from the preview

ai.title: Generate with Product Agent
ai.hint: You describe intent and review; the Product Agent writes the HTML and snapshots every version.
ai.briefPlaceholder: e.g. A SaaS landing page: top nav, three feature cards, bottom CTA, purple accent, Material Design 3 style
ai.newHint: Creates a new prototype and hands it to the Product Agent.
ai.iterateHint: Iterates on the selected prototype (creates a new version).
ai.runningHint: {{agent}} is writing the prototype; it will load into the editor when done.
ai.succeeded: Prototype generated and loaded — keep giving feedback to iterate
